ERR_PROV_NOT_FOUND.hint: Check the provider ID or create the provider first.

ERR_PROV_EXISTS.hint: Choose another provider ID or remove the existing one first.

ERR_PROV_FULL.message: No free slot for another data provider
ERR_PROV_FULL.hint: Remove an unused data provider or raise CONFIG_SYS_DATA_PROVIDER_MAX.

ERR_PROV_IN_USE.hint: Wait until active transfers finish or detach the session before closing or removing the provider.

ERR_PROV_SYSTEM.hint: Built-in board providers cannot be removed.

ERR_PROV_DOWN.hint: Check the physical connection or reconnect the peer before sending.

ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.message: Frame for provider {provider} is too long ({len} bytes, limit {max})
ERR_PROV_TOO_LONG.hint: Reduce the payload size so the complete frame fits within the provider limit.

ERR_PROV_BUSY.message: Data provider {provider} send queue is full
ERR_PROV_BUSY.hint: Wait briefly or reduce traffic on this provider.

ERR_PROV_LOCAL_OP.message: Provider operation {op} is local to firmware only

ERR_PROV_NO_MEM.message: Out of memory creating provider {provider} ({size} bytes needed)
ERR_PROV_NO_MEM.hint: Free memory by removing unused providers or devices.
